experiment: W1 wave-field validity and estimand audit
estimand_rule: Fixed-energy variance suppression is quantified against an unconditional Gaussian process but is not an additional undeclared gate; the production estimand is already conditional on deterministic amplitudes and random phases.
labeled_window_exposure: D1/D5/F1 use at most 60 natural periods of history plus 50 natural periods of outcome: 440 s at the anchored 4 s natural period. The recurrence gate is therefore evaluated through 440 s, while the full 0--600 s curve and endpoint recovery are still reported.
pass_decision_verbatim: Every preregistered Phase-1 gate passed on the production construction. Record invariance; keep all campaigns; W1 closes as a validity note with the fixed-energy, random-phase, periodic discrete-spectrum estimand unchanged.
fail_decision_verbatim: At least one preregistered Phase-1 gate failed materially on the production construction. Quantify exposed downstream statistics and regenerate only exposed campaigns under the extended-period construction on fresh ordinary TEST seeds as _w1 versions; frozen experiments remain untouched and are annotated for exposure only.
reserves: RESERVE and RESERVE2 are prohibited; only fresh ordinary TEST seeds 290000--290499 may be synthesized.
artifact_policy: New result and figure names begin with w1_ and end with _w1; existing artifacts are immutable.
